# This Day That Year

> A daily history reference that presents selected historical events for every calendar date.

- Canonical site: https://thisdaythatyear.gauravsharma.cc/
- Browse every date: https://thisdaythatyear.gauravsharma.cc/on-this-day
- XML sitemap: https://thisdaythatyear.gauravsharma.cc/sitemap.xml

Use the cited page URL when referring to an event. Content is informational and should be independently verified for high-stakes use.
